notes: Numeric craft ranges per audience band for puzzle / coloring / journal / printable products. Reused by the design-policy engine (reading_level_target) and by audience specialists. Word ranges apply to instructional/prompt text, not puzzle grids.

guidance: Very large art and type; one activity idea per page
Instructions in a single short sentence with an icon
Forgiving difficulty; no time pressure
Big, well-separated grid cells and dot-to-dot numbers
Clear grids with generous cell size
Short, literal instructions with an example
Easy-to-medium ramp; celebrate completion
Word lists drawn from familiar vocabulary
Denser puzzles and mixed types per section
Introduce strategy tips for harder puzzle types
Black-and-white grids; colour only on dedicated art pages
Progressive difficulty with a clear front-to-back ramp
Standard adult-scale grids and difficulty
Concise instructions; assume puzzle literacy
Mixed difficulty distribution across the book
Full-difficulty grids; clear difficulty labels
Solutions grouped back-only
Journals: open, reflective prompts with generous writing space
Large-print type (>= 16pt body) and oversized grids
High contrast; avoid low-contrast greys and thin rules
One puzzle per page with ample white space
Simple, unambiguous instructions
